role: Extension defining the injury Concept (first-person injury reports in English, European, Nordic, Russian latin-script patterns plus ja/zh/ko/ar substrings) and the refuseAsInjury group used by MedicalQueryGuard.
types: MedicalTermLexicon: extension — injury concept and its locale pattern lists
toplevel: All static lets: injury Concept assembled from englishInjury + europeanInjury + nordicInjury + Russian literals, unbounded CJK/Arabic substrings; idiom lookaheads exclude 'fell asleep/behind/...', 'cut myself slack', 'bleeding edge', French/Spanish 'racked my brain' forms. The English injury nouns count only in a report shape: 'sprained', 'concussed', 'I (think I) have/got/had / it's / might/may/could be (a) sprain|concussion', '<is/are/it's/keeps/won't stop/started> bleeding', 'bleeding badly/heavily/a lot', 'call/need/get/send (me) (an) ambulance'. Several non-English bare nouns remain (entorse, esguince, distorsione, verstaucht, forstuvet, stukat, hjernerystelse, 捻挫, 骨折, 염좌, 골절, ...). refuseAsInjury = [injury].
